setup.frontend_tests: cd frontend; npm run build; npx playwright test

episodes.title: The Frame Behind This
episodes.build: Capture synchronized camera, microphone, and monotonic timing evidence.
episodes.mode: Local browser; camera and microphone permission
episodes.demo: Point at an object, speak, and inspect the paired frame, audio interval, and JSONL event.

episodes.title: An Evidence Event
episodes.build: Define and validate the evidence-event contract.
episodes.demo: Reject malformed regions and time ranges before they enter world state.

episodes.title: Keep Each Modality Honest
episodes.build: Separate provider output from normalized observations.
episodes.mode: Live Gemini run requires GOOGLE_API_KEY; retained replay does not
episodes.demo: Compare raw provider evidence with the normalized event.

episodes.title: Build the First World State
episodes.build: Reduce immutable evidence events into queryable world state.
episodes.demo: Ask for the latest supported object location without mutating source evidence.

episodes.title: Pixels Are Not Objects
episodes.build: Convert safely among pixel, normalized, and display coordinates.
episodes.demo: Map a model region onto a resized UI without shifting the overlay.

episodes.title: Ground the Claim
episodes.build: Require claims to carry regions and source evidence.
episodes.mode: Live Gemini run requires GOOGLE_API_KEY; retained replay does not
episodes.demo: Draw the cited region and distinguish observation from inference.

episodes.title: Read the Scene
episodes.build: Extract a structured scene graph from visual evidence.
episodes.mode: Live Gemini run requires GOOGLE_API_KEY; retained replay does not
episodes.demo: Inspect objects, relations, confidence, and provenance together.

episodes.title: Test What the Agent Sees
episodes.build: Evaluate vision under blur, darkness, compression, and low resolution.
episodes.mode: Live Gemini run optional; fixtures and tests are deterministic
episodes.demo: Compare the robustness matrix rather than trusting one clean image.

episodes.title: An Image Has No Before
episodes.build: Represent ordered observations and change events.
episodes.demo: Show what changed between two frames and preserve event time.

episodes.title: Sample What Matters
episodes.build: Compare uniform and change-aware video sampling.
episodes.demo: Recover a short event that uniform sampling misses.

episodes.title: Find the Moment
episodes.build: Retrieve evidence intervals instead of isolated frames.
episodes.demo: Return start/end timestamps and score temporal overlap.

episodes.title: Resolve This While the World Moves
episodes.build: Join speech references to the correct live visual context.
episodes.run: cd frontend; npx playwright test --grep "live session"
episodes.demo: Resolve ‘this’ against event time rather than the newest frame.

episodes.title: See the Screen, Read the Interface
episodes.build: Capture screen state as visual and structured evidence.
episodes.run: cd frontend; npx playwright test --grep "screen state"
episodes.demo: Inspect the screenshot and accessibility-derived state side by side.

episodes.title: Prefer Structure When It Exists
episodes.build: Fuse pixels with DOM or accessibility evidence and preserve disagreements.
episodes.demo: Prefer a stable structured selector while retaining visual confirmation.

episodes.title: Turn Observations into Actions
episodes.build: Create typed proposals, risk checks, and confirmation boundaries.
episodes.demo: Allow a read action and block a high-impact action without confirmation.

episodes.title: Build a Safe Screen Agent
episodes.build: Join perception, planning, policy, action, and postcondition checks.
episodes.demo: Execute a reversible action and prove its postcondition.

episodes.title: A Page Is More Than Its Text
episodes.build: Extract text, tables, figures, captions, and layout relations.
episodes.demo: Retrieve a figure with its caption and supporting paragraph.

episodes.title: Search Beyond Text
episodes.build: Index multimodal records locally and in Qdrant.
episodes.run: docker compose -f deploy/qdrant/docker-compose.yml up -d; uv sync --extra gemini; uv run python -m multimodal_agents.run_qdrant_search runs/local/qdrant-search.json
episodes.mode: Docker and local Qdrant; live embedding requires GEMINI_API_KEY
episodes.demo: Search the same records through the reference index and Qdrant.

episodes.title: Cross-Modal Search
episodes.build: Use text to retrieve images and images to retrieve related evidence.
episodes.mode: Live Gemini run requires GOOGLE_API_KEY; retained replay does not
episodes.demo: Issue a text query and inspect the ranked visual evidence.

episodes.title: Hybrid Retrieval and Reranking
episodes.build: Fuse lexical, vector, and metadata signals with explainable scores.
episodes.demo: Explain why the reranker promoted one evidence item.

episodes.title: Multimodal RAG with Citations
episodes.build: Assemble bounded evidence packages and modality-specific citations.
episodes.mode: Deterministic evidence assembly; provider generation optional
episodes.demo: Trace every answer claim to a page, region, or time interval.

episodes.title: Memory Is an Event Store
episodes.build: Persist append-only multimodal events and materialize state.
episodes.demo: Rebuild current state from immutable events.

episodes.title: Ask the Past
episodes.build: Query memory by entity, time, modality, and evidence relation.
episodes.demo: Find what was on screen when a deployment failed.

episodes.title: Audio Beyond Speech
episodes.build: Detect and localize non-speech acoustic events.
episodes.demo: Localize an alarm interval without transcribing it as speech.

episodes.title: Sensors and World State
episodes.build: Normalize timestamped sensor readings into shared world state.
episodes.demo: Correlate a temperature rise with camera and audio evidence.

episodes.title: When Modalities Disagree
episodes.build: Represent contradictions without silently overwriting evidence.
episodes.demo: Escalate when camera and sensor disagree about the door.

episodes.title: Evidence Before Action
episodes.build: Gate actions on provenance, freshness, corroboration, and risk.
episodes.demo: Show the exact missing evidence that blocks an action.

episodes.title: Build the Multimodal Sandbox
episodes.build: Replay time-aligned world scenarios with known ground truth.
episodes.demo: Replay the same scenario and obtain the same evidence timeline.

episodes.title: Evaluate Every Boundary
episodes.build: Score perception, retrieval, grounding, policy, and outcomes separately.
episodes.demo: Locate the failing boundary instead of hiding it in one aggregate score.

episodes.title: Break It Deliberately
episodes.build: Inject stale, missing, delayed, corrupted, and contradictory evidence.
episodes.demo: Prove the runtime degrades safely under each injected failure.

episodes.title: Design the Runtime
episodes.build: Add bounded queues, tracing, metrics, and backpressure.
episodes.demo: Observe queue depth, dropped work, latency, and trace linkage.

episodes.title: Build IAgentic Multimodal Studio
episodes.build: Assemble the React and TypeScript operator experience.
episodes.run: cd frontend; npm run build; npx playwright test --grep "studio coordinates"; cd ..
episodes.demo: Follow evidence from timeline to source, decision, and action.

episodes.title: Deploy Without Losing the Evidence
episodes.build: Run production-shaped services with health, security, and persistence controls.
episodes.mode: Docker locally; Oracle Cloud deployment optional
episodes.demo: Restart services and show that evidence persists and health checks recover.

episodes.title: Release with Tenant Boundaries
episodes.build: Enforce Auth0 organization identity and PostgreSQL row-level isolation.
episodes.mode: Offline release replay by default; --live requires two Auth0 organization tokens and PostgreSQL
episodes.demo: Prove two tenants can read their own evidence and cannot read each other’s rows.
